entries.decision: Decorate only an actual GNSS V1.0 XSD INVALID result caused by using the PDF spelling HorizontalDilutionOfPrecision instead of the selected-XSD element HoriziontalDilutionOfPrecision.
guards: official GNSSLocationService V1.0 strict profile only
match only exact element name HorizontalDilutionOfPrecision in GNSSLocationService.Data
must preserve HoriziontalDilutionOfPrecision as the authoritative selected-XSD XML name
must not accept or normalize the PDF spelling as an alias
must not generalize spelling correction to other GNSS identifiers
